title: Agentforce Live A2A Profile — common definitions
description: Shared enums and reusable subschemas for the Agentforce Live A2A profile v0.1. Metadata keys are shown abbreviated with the 'afl/' prefix, which expands to 'https://schemas.salesforce.com/a2a/ext/realtime-agent/v0.1/'. Referenced by the other schemas in this directory.

directiveType.description: Directive name from the negotiated set (spec §7).

eventType.description: Value of the afl/eventType metadata key (spec §5).

textForm.description: Value of the afl/textForm metadata key on a spoken TextPart (spec §5, §6.2).

renderMode.description: Value of the afl/renderMode metadata key on a spoken directive TextPart (spec §5, §7).

sequenceId.description: Monotonic, turn-scoped ordering key assigned by the Reasoner to every directive event (spec §5).

textPart.description: An A2A TextPart. Spoken parts SHOULD carry afl/textForm metadata; an untagged text part is interpreted as transcript (spec §6.2).

dataPart.description: An A2A DataPart carrying a structured 'data' object.
